summary: Iteration 9 — Verified USD-only pricing fix on Stripe Checkout. (1) Backend POST /api/payments/checkout with the exact iter-9 payload returns HTTP 200 with checkout_url starting https://checkout.stripe.com/ and session_id starting cs_test_. (2) Stripe Checkout page now displays 'US$4.99 per month' (confirmed via screenshot + JS console: {"amount":"4.99","currencyCode":"usd"}). No EUR / €5.45 anywhere. (3) Full end-to-end purchase with test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 → redirect to /payment/success?session_id=... → access-pill-pro visible on home → new question does NOT reopen paywall. (4) Regression suite (7 pytest tests) all pass: health/payments_configured, checkout creation, payment_status before payment, unknown subscription status, restore unknown email, restore invalid email (422), verse-of-day.
critical_code_review_comments: adaptive_pricing={'enabled': False} correctly forces USD display for every buyer regardless of geo — verified visually on the Stripe Checkout page (US$4.99) and via Stripe.js console log (currencyCode: usd).

The 3-tier fallback (managed_payments → automatic_tax → plain) in /api/payments/checkout is defensive and works — the first tier (managed_payments) succeeded in this environment, producing the accordion-style SMP checkout UI (Card / Cash App Pay / Bank as radios). Card fields become accessible after clicking the Card accordion row.

Note: iteration_8 pre-fix Stripe UI exposed input[name=cardNumber] directly; post-fix under SMP the payment methods are collapsed under an accordion. This is a Stripe SMP UI difference, not a bug, but any future Playwright tests need to click the Card accordion label (label wrapping input#payment-method-accordion-item-title-card) before card fields appear.

polling-based /api/payments/status flow still works — after redirect back the success page briefly shows 'Verifying your subscription...' then transitions; PRO entitlement is granted once polling resolves.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix from iteration_9 (adaptive_pricing.enabled=false + fallback chain) is verified working. The active Stripe Checkout in this environment is Stripe Managed Payments (SMP), where Card is a radio in an accordion. To automate card fill, first click the label wrapping input#payment-method-accordion-item-title-card, then wait for input[name=cardNumber] to appear. Prior test subscriptions (iter8: testpurchase-1786666293@example.com, iter9: usdpurchase-1786667058@example.com) exist in Stripe test mode and can be used for restore-flow tests. Do not use page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle') on the Stripe Checkout page — Stripe holds long-poll connections and networkidle never fires. Use domcontentloaded + fixed wait_for_timeout instead.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. The iteration_8 UX inconsistency (€5.45 EUR shown on Stripe) is resolved. Root cause of the prior issue was Stripe's adaptive-pricing feature which auto-converts the price to the buyer's local currency (with VAT for EU). The fix disables adaptive_pricing so every buyer sees the exact USD amount (4.99) that the paywall advertises. Verified via console log: 'Estimated order amount for sandbox is {"amount":"4.99","currencyCode":"usd"}' and visible on-page text 'US$4.99 per month'.
